targets.summary: The test asserts on generated IR/graph code strings (absence of aten.index.Tensor, presence of aten.select.int); the reviewer dislikes these brittle IR checks and wants the test to verify behavior instead (e.g., numerical correctness).
targets.evidence: Before the change, the test made IR string assertions: `self.assertNotIn("torch.ops.aten.index.Tensor", traced.graph_module.code)` and `FileCheck().check("torch.ops.aten.select.int").run(traced.graph_module.code)`, and the comment sits on the closing `)` of that FileCheck call. In the merged code both IR checks are gone. `traced = export(MyModel(), (x, y)).run_decompositions({})` became just `traced = export(MyModel(), (x, y))`. What remains is the behavioral check: `self.assertEqual(traced.module()(x, y2), ...)`, which compares outputs for a second input. So the brittle IR checks were removed and the test now checks numerical behavior, as the maintainer asked.
